answer_1.quote: Sequence-to-Sequence. Considering the available baseline results, we use the Gigaword dataset for abstractive summarization and the SQuAD 1.1 dataset for question generation as the benchmarks for models pretrained on BookCorpus and Wikipedia. Additionally, we use the CNN/DailyMail and XSum datasets for abstractive summarization as the benchmarks for models pretrained on larger corpora.
answer_1.outputs: Generated summaries, questions, and text infills

answer_2.quote: The evaluation metrics are the F1 scores of Rouge-1, Rouge-2, and Rouge-L on the test set. For question generation, the evaluation metrics are the scores of BLEU-1, BLEU-2, BLEU-3, BLEU-4, METEOR and Rouge-L. The evaluation metric is the BLEU score of the infilled text against the original document. We evaluate the model's ability of language modeling with perplexity on BookWiki and accuracy on the LAMBDA dataset.
